vocabulary.title: Q1 - Describe your house....
idioms: "There’s no place like home" - "Uyga teng joy yo'q"
four walls and a roof - "to'rt devor va tom"
sentenceStarters: "Honestly speaking, I am quite fond of my humble abode..." - "Rostini aytsam, men o'zimning oddiy boshpanamni juda yaxshi ko'raman..."
"From my perspective, my house is a sanctuary where I find solace..." - "Mening nuqtai nazarimdan, mening uyim taskin topadigan muqaddas joy..."
"I'd have to say that my house is a perfect blend of comfort and style..." - "Shuni aytishim kerakki, mening uyim qulaylik va uslubning mukammal uyg'unligi..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
Well, to begin with, my house is truly a sanctuary for me. It's located in a serene residential area, offering a peaceful retreat from the hustle and bustle of city life. The house itself is a two-storey building with a charming facade that boasts a combination of traditional and contemporary elements, making it stand out in the neighborhood.

When you step into the house, you're greeted by a spacious living room, which is beautifully adorned with art pieces that I've collected over the years. The living room seamlessly flows into the dining area, creating an open-plan space that's perfect for hosting friends and family. I've put a lot of effort into making this area cozy and inviting, with plush sofas and a state-of-the-art entertainment system.

Upstairs, there are three bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bathroom. My personal favorite is the master bedroom, which has a large bay window overlooking the garden. This room is my little slice of heaven where I can let my hair down after a long day. One of the standout features of my house is the magnificent garden, which is meticulously maintained and provides a perfect space for outdoor gatherings or simply enjoying a quiet morning coffee.

Overall, my house is not just a place to live, but rather a reflection of my personality and taste. It's a place where I can express myself and truly feel at home. After all, "home is where the heart is," and my heart genuinely resides here.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Xo'sh, boshlash uchun, uyim men uchun haqiqatan ham panohgohdir. U shahar shovqinidan xoli, sokin turar-joy hududida joylashgan bo'lib, tinchgina dam olish imkoniyatini beradi. Uyning o'zi ikki qavatli bino bo'lib, an'anaviy va zamonaviy elementlarning kombinatsiyasini o'zida mujassam etgan jozibali fasadga ega, bu esa uni mahallada ajralib turishiga yordam beradi.

Uyga kirishingiz bilan sizni keng mehmonxona kutib oladi, u men yillar davomida to'plagan san'at asarlari bilan chiroyli bezatilgan. Mehmonxona ovqatlanish xonasiga uzluksiz o'tadi va do'stlar va oilani qabul qilish uchun juda mos bo'lgan ochiq rejadagi maydonni yaratadi. Men bu hududni yumshoq divanlar va eng zamonaviy ko'ngilochar tizim bilan qulay va jozibali qilish uchun ko'p harakat qildim.

Yuqori qavatda uchta yotoqxona mavjud, ularning har biri o'zining alohida hammomiga ega. Mening eng sevimli joyim - bog'ga qaragan katta derazaga ega bo'lgan asosiy yotoqxona. Bu xona mening kichik jannat burchagim, u erda uzoq kundan keyin dam olishim mumkin. Mening uyimning ajralib turadigan xususiyatlaridan biri bu ajoyib bog'dir, u juda ehtiyotkorlik bilan saqlanadi va ochiq havoda yig'ilishlar yoki shunchaki sokin ertalabki qahvani ichish uchun ajoyib joydir.

Umuman olganda, mening uyim shunchaki yashash joyi emas, balki mening shaxsiyatim va didimning aksidir. Bu men o'zimni ifoda eta oladigan va haqiqatan ham o'zimni uyda his qila oladigan joy. Axir, "uy - bu yurak joylashgan joy", va mening yuragim chin dildan shu erda.

idioms: "The early bird catches the worm" - "Erta turgan odamga omad kuladi"
sentenceStarters: "Honestly speaking, I tend to..." - "Rostini aytsam, men odatda..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
Well, I typically get up quite early, around 6 a.m. every day, and I believe this habit has set me up for a productive day. I’ve always been a morning person, and I find that "the early bird catches the worm" truly holds some merit. In the early morning, the world is remarkably quiet, and it allows me to focus on my tasks without any distractions. I kick off my day with a cup of coffee and some light reading, which gets me in the right frame of mind for the challenges ahead.

Of course, there are days when I feel like hitting the snooze button, but I honestly believe that waking up early has significantly improved my time management skills. Moreover, it has given me the chance to embrace the day fully before it becomes hectic and overwhelming. Ultimately, getting up early has become an integral part of my daily routine, and I wouldn’t trade it for anything.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Xo'sh, men odatda har kuni ertalab soat 6 atrofida juda erta turaman va bu odat meni samarali kun uchun tayyorladi deb hisoblayman. Men doim ertalabki odam bo'lganman va "ertalab turgan qush o'ljasini oladi" degan maqolning qandaydir ma'nosi bor deb o'ylayman. Ertalab dunyo juda sokin bo'ladi va bu menga hech qanday chalg'ituvchi omillarsiz vazifalarimga e'tibor qaratishga imkon beradi. Men kunni bir chashka qahva va biroz yengil o'qish bilan boshlayman, bu meni oldindagi qiyinchiliklar uchun to'g'ri kayfiyatga keltiradi.

Albatta, ba'zida "snooze" tugmasini bosgim keladigan kunlar bo'ladi, lekin men erta uyg'onish vaqtni boshqarish qobiliyatimni sezilarli darajada yaxshilaganiga chin dildan ishonaman. Bundan tashqari, bu menga kun gavjum va og'ir bo'lishidan oldin uni to'liq qabul qilish imkoniyatini berdi. Umuman olganda, erta turish mening kundalik tartibimning ajralmas qismiga aylandi va men uni hech narsaga almashtirmayman.

questions.sampleAnswer: To be perfectly honest, my favourite drink is freshly brewed coffee. There is something incredibly invigorating about the aroma that wafts through the air when you brew a cup. It's not just a beverage; it’s an entire sensory experience. I picked up the habit of drinking coffee during my university years when I often had to burn the midnight oil to meet assignment deadlines. I genuinely believe that coffee, "like a good friend, is there when you need it most". Additionally, I relish the social experience of having coffee with friends or colleagues. It's a great way to catch up and exchange ideas, often leading to a meeting of minds. While there are many delightful drinks out there, coffee holds a special place in my heart for both its taste and its role in my daily routine.
questions.uzSampleAnswer: Rostini aytsam, mening eng sevimli ichimligim – yangi damlangan qahva. Bir chashka qahva damlaganingizda havoga taraladigan xushbo'y hidda g'ayrioddiy tetiklantiruvchi bir narsa bor. Bu shunchaki ichimlik emas; bu butun bir hissiy tajriba. Men qahva ichish odatini universitet yillarida, topshiriqlar muddatlariga ulgurish uchun ko'pincha tunni kunduzga ulashimga to'g'ri kelgan paytlarda o'rganganman. Men chin dildan ishonamanki, qahva, "yaxshi do'st kabi, eng kerak bo'lgan paytda yoningda bo'ladi". Bundan tashqari, do'stlar yoki hamkasblar bilan qahva ichishning ijtimoiy tajribasidan zavqlanaman. Bu suhbatlashish va fikr almashishning ajoyib usuli bo'lib, ko'pincha fikrlar uyg'unligiga olib keladi. U yerda ko'plab ajoyib ichimliklar mavjud bo'lsa-da, qahva o'zining ta'mi va kundalik hayotimdagi roli uchun qalbimda alohida o'rin egallaydi.

questions.prompt: What do you see in these pictures?
questions.sampleA1: I see people. I see a plane. I see a train.
questions.sampleA2: In the first picture, I see a family. They are going to the airplane. And in the second picture, I see a woman. She is looking out the window of the train because she is happy.
questions.sampleB1: Okay, in the first picture, I can see a family at the airport. They are probably going on holiday. In the second picture, there is a woman on a train. She is looking outside and it looks very green. I think she is enjoying the view. Maybe she is going on a trip too.
questions.sampleB2: So, looking at the first picture, I can see a young family crossing the tarmac towards a big plane, and they’re clearly off on holiday — the parents are wheeling their suitcases along while their little girl skips happily between them. The second one, on the other hand, shows a woman leaning out of a bright blue train, beaming as it winds through these lush green hills. To sum up, both shots capture the joy of travelling, though one’s all about flying off somewhere and the other’s a slower, more scenic journey.

questions.sampleAnswer:
So, in the first picture, well, I can see a family at an airport, and they're clearly getting ready to board a plane. The thing is, the parents seem to be traveling with a young child, and they're pulling wheeled suitcases across the runway toward the aircraft. Their relaxed body language and casual clothing kind of suggest that this is a leisure trip rather than, you know, a business journey. Overall, the scene conveys a sense of excitement and anticipation, as air travel is often associated with holidays and new experiences.

Anyway, in the second picture, there's this woman leaning out of a train window while the train moves through a lush, green landscape, possibly in a rural or mountainous area. She looks cheerful and engaged with her surroundings, maybe enjoying the scenery or capturing the moment. The train itself seems quite traditional, which might indicate travel in a developing region or a popular tourist route known for its natural beauty.

By the way, taken together, both images illustrate different modes of travel and highlight the joy of exploration. While the first image represents modern, fast-paced air travel with a focus on family convenience, the second emphasizes a slower, more immersive journey that allows travelers to connect closely with nature and their environment. Personally, I think both types of travel have their own unique charm.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Demak, birinchi rasmda, hmm, men aeroportda bir oilani ko'ryapman va ular aniq samolyotga chiqishga tayyorlanyapti. Gap shundaki, ota-onalar yosh bola bilan sayohat qilishayotganga o'xshaydi va ular g'ildirakli chamadonlarni uchish yo'lagi bo'ylab samolyot tomon tortib ketishyapti. Ularning xotirjam tana tili va kundalik kiyimlari bu biznes safaridan ko'ra ko'ngilochar sayohat ekanligini ko'rsatadi. Umuman olganda, bu sahna hayajon va umidvorlik hissini uyg'otadi, chunki havo sayohati ko'pincha ta'tillar va yangi tajribalar bilan bog'liq.

Xullas, ikkinchi rasmda bir ayol poyezd oynasidan tashqariga egilib turibdi, poyezd esa yam-yashil manzarali, ehtimol qishloq yoki tog'li hududdan o'tib ketyapti. U xursand va atrof-muhit bilan qiziqayotganga o'xshaydi, balki manzaradan zavqlanayotgandir yoki shu lahzani suratga olayotgandir. Poyezdning o'zi ancha an'anaviy ko'rinadi, bu rivojlanayotgan mintaqada sayohatni yoki o'zining tabiiy go'zalligi bilan mashhur bo'lgan mashhur sayyohlik yo'nalishini ko'rsatishi mumkin.

Aytgancha, birgalikda olganda, ikkala rasm ham sayohatning turli usullarini tasvirlaydi va tadqiq qilish zavqini ta'kidlaydi. Birinchi rasm oilaviy qulaylikka qaratilgan zamonaviy, tezkor havo sayohatini ifodalasa, ikkinchisi sayohatchilarga tabiat va atrof-muhit bilan yaqinroq aloqa qilish imkonini beradigan sekinroq, yanada chuqur sayohatni ta'kidlaydi. Shaxsan men, sayohatning ikkala turi ham o'ziga xos jozibaga ega deb o'ylayman.

questions.prompt: What are the benefits of travelling by train?
questions.sampleA1: Train good. I like train. It is easy. I see things.
questions.sampleA2: I like the train. It's good because I can sit down. And I can read a book. But sometimes it is slow. I like to see the houses and trees.
questions.sampleB1: I think travelling by train is good. For example, you can relax and look out the window. Also, it's often more comfortable than a bus. However, sometimes the train is late, which is annoying. But overall, I prefer it to driving because I don't have to concentrate.
questions.sampleB2: Well, there are loads of upsides, to be honest. For one thing, you can just sit back and take in the scenery instead of keeping your eyes on the road. On top of that, trains are far greener than cars or planes, and the stations are usually smack in the middle of town, so getting around afterwards is a breeze.
questions.uzSampleA1: Poyezd yaxshi. Menga poyezd yoqadi. Bu oson. Men narsalarni ko'raman.
questions.uzSampleA2: Menga poyezdda sayohat qilish yoqadi. Yaxshi, chunki men o'tira olaman. Va men kitob o'qiy olaman. Lekin ba'zan u sekin bo'ladi. Menga uylar va daraxtlarni ko'rish yoqadi.
questions.uzSampleB1: Menimcha, poyezdda sayohat qilish yaxshi. Misol uchun, siz dam olib, derazadan tashqariga qarashingiz mumkin. Shuningdek, u ko'pincha avtobusdan qulayroq. Biroq, ba'zida poyezd kechikadi, bu esa asabiylashtiradi. Lekin umuman olganda, men haydashdan ko'ra uni afzal ko'raman, chunki men diqqat qilishim shart emas.
questions.uzSampleB2: Poyezdda sayohat qilishning bir nechta afzalliklari bor. Birinchidan, bu ko'pincha mashina haydashdan ko'ra ancha qulayroq, chunki siz kitob o'qishingiz, ishlashingiz yoki shunchaki manzaradan bahramand bo'lishingiz mumkin. Ikkinchidan, poyezdda sayohat qilish samolyotda uchish yoki yolg'iz mashina haydashdan ko'ra ekologik jihatdan toza bo'lishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, poyezd stantsiyalari ko'pincha shahar markazlarida joylashgan bo'lib, keyingi sayohatni yanada qulay qiladi. Albatta, kechikishlar bo'lishi mumkin, lekin umuman olganda, afzalliklari kamchiliklardan ustun turadi, ayniqsa qulaylik muhim bo'lgan uzoq masofalar uchun.

vocabulary.title: Q5 - What are the benefits of travelling by train?...
idioms: "Smooth as a train ride" - "Poezd yurishiday tekis"
sentenceStarters: "Honestly speaking, I believe that train travel offers a unique blend of comfort and efficiency." - "Rostini aytsam, menimcha, poezdda sayohat qilish qulaylik va samaradorlikning noyob uyg'unligini taklif etadi."

"From my perspective, travelling by train is an environmentally friendly alternative to other modes of transportation." - "Mening nuqtai nazarimdan, poezdda sayohat qilish boshqa transport turlariga nisbatan ekologik jihatdan qulayroq alternativadir."
"I'd have to say that the scenic views from a train can be unparalleled." - "Shuni aytishim kerakki, poezddan ko‘rinadigan manzaralar benazir bo‘lishi mumkin."

questions.sampleAnswer:
Travelling by train offers a myriad of benefits that truly enhance the travel experience. First and foremost, it provides a social experience that many other forms of transportation simply cannot match. The ability to move around freely in a train, the chance to meet new people or let your hair down in the dining car, and the opportunity to enjoy scenic views through panoramic windows, all contribute to a memorable journey.

Moreover, trains are often more environmentally friendly than cars or planes. They cut down on carbon emissions, making them a more sustainable option for the eco-conscious traveler. On top of that, the convenience of train stations located in city centers means getting to your destination is typically easier and more efficient.

"Travel broadens the mind", and I wholeheartedly believe that the comfort and ease of train travel play a part in facilitating this. You can sit back, relax, and take in the beautiful landscapes without the stress and hassle of navigating traffic or worrying about flight delays.

For me personally, one of the greatest joys of train travel is the sense of timelessness it imparts. As someone who enjoys reading, I find that trains provide the perfect environment to lose myself in a novel while the world outside rushes by. All in all, train travel is a perfect blend of leisure, convenience, and sustainability.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Poyezdda sayohat qilish sayohat tajribasini chinakamiga yaxshilaydigan ko'plab afzalliklarni taqdim etadi. Avvalo, u transportning boshqa ko'plab turlari ta'minlay olmaydigan ijtimoiy tajribani taqdim etadi. Poyezdda erkin harakatlanish imkoniyati, yangi odamlar bilan tanishish yoki vagon-restoranda bemalol dam olish imkoniyati va panoramali derazalar orqali go'zal manzaralardan bahramand bo'lish imkoniyati - bularning barchasi unutilmas sayohatga hissa qo'shadi.

Bundan tashqari, poyezdlar ko'pincha avtomobillar yoki samolyotlarga qaraganda ekologik jihatdan toza hisoblanadi. Ular karbonat angidrid chiqindilarini kamaytiradi, bu ularni ekologiyaga e'tiborli sayohatchilar uchun yanada barqaror variantga aylantiradi. Bundan tashqari, shahar markazlarida joylashgan vokzallarning qulayligi manzilingizga yetib borish odatda osonroq va samaraliroq ekanligini anglatadi.

"Sayohat insonning dunyoqarashini kengaytiradi", va men poyezdda sayohatning qulayligi va osonligi bunga yordam berishiga chin dildan ishonaman. Siz bemalol o'tirib, dam olib, tirbandlikni boshqarish yoki reys kechikishi haqida tashvishlanmasdan go'zal manzaralardan bahramand bo'lishingiz mumkin.

Shaxsan men uchun poyezdda sayohat qilishning eng katta zavqlaridan biri bu vaqt o'tishi sezilmasligidir. Kitob o'qishni yaxshi ko'radigan odam sifatida, poyezdlar tashqi dunyo shiddat bilan o'tib ketayotgan bir paytda romanga berilib ketish uchun ideal muhitni ta'minlaydi deb bilaman. Umuman olganda, poyezdda sayohat qilish - bu hordiq chiqarish, qulaylik va barqarorlikning mukammal uyg'unligidir.

questions.sampleAnswer:
Personally, I absolutely love traveling by train. There's something incredibly charming about being able to sit back and watch the scenery pass by without having to worry about traffic or navigating through an airport. In many cases, train travel can be surprisingly efficient and cost-effective, especially when traveling within a country or on a continent like Europe, where the railway network is extensive and well-connected.

Beyond the practicalities, I find that trains offer a unique social experience. You often meet people from all walks of life and can strike up a conversation in a way that's rarely possible on other modes of transport. It's amazing how many fascinating stories and insights you can pick up just by chatting with a fellow passenger.

That being said, I do enjoy flying when it's necessary. It's unquestionably the fastest way to cover long distances, and the excitement of taking off and landing never gets old for me. However, given the choice, I would choose train travel over flying because, as the old saying goes, "It's the journey, not the destination." This holds true for me, as I find that the journey by train offers so much more than simply getting from point A to point B.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Shaxsan men, poyezdda sayohat qilishni juda yaxshi ko'raman. O'tirib olib, tirbandlik yoki aeroportda yo'l topish haqida qayg'urmasdan, manzaralarning o'tib ketayotganini kuzatishning o'ziga xos jozibasi bor. Ko'p hollarda, poyezdda sayohat qilish hayratlanarli darajada samarali va tejamkor bo'lishi mumkin, ayniqsa bir mamlakat ichida yoki Yevropa kabi qit'ada sayohat qilganda, u yerda temir yo'l tarmog'i keng va yaxshi bog'langan.

Amaliy tomonlaridan tashqari, poyezdlar o'ziga xos ijtimoiy tajribani taqdim etadi deb o'ylayman. Ko'pincha hayotning turli qatlamlaridan bo'lgan odamlar bilan uchrashasiz va transportning boshqa turlarida kamdan-kam uchraydigan tarzda suhbatni boshlashingiz mumkin. Yo'lovchi bilan suhbatlashib, qanchalik ko'p qiziqarli hikoyalar va tushunchalarni o'rganishingiz mumkinligi hayratlanarli.

Shunga qaramay, zarur bo'lganda samolyotda uchish ham yoqadi. Bu uzoq masofalarni bosib o'tishning eng tezkor usuli ekanligi shubhasiz va havoga ko'tarilish va qo'nish hayajoni men uchun hech qachon eskirib qolmaydi. Biroq, tanlash imkoniyati bo'lsa, men poyezdda sayohat qilishni samolyotda uchishdan afzal ko'raman, chunki eski maqolda aytilganidek, "Muhimi manzil emas, sayohatning o'zi". Bu men uchun ham to'g'ri, chunki poyezdda sayohat qilish A nuqtadan B nuqtaga shunchaki yetib borishdan ko'ra ancha ko'p narsani taklif etadi.

questions.sampleB1: I ran a marathon last year. It was difficult, but I finished it. I felt really proud of myself. I trained a lot before the race. I think it's important to have a goal and work hard to achieve it.

He kept drumming it into me that practice makes perfect, and looking back, he was absolutely spot on. On the big day, I was a bundle of nerves — my hands were shaking on the wheel and my heart was pounding. But somehow I managed to keep a cool head, went through all the manoeuvres, and when the examiner told me I’d passed, I could hardly believe my ears. As for how I felt, well, I was over the moon. bulletPoints: Describe a time when you achieved a great goal.
Describe a person who influenced you.
How you felt about this achievement?
questions.sampleAnswer:
Reflecting on my past experiences, a significant milestone that stands out is when I completed my first marathon. Honestly, it was a monumental achievement for me, not just physically but also mentally.

The journey towards this goal was incredibly challenging. I picked up running as a hobby during my university years, initially as a way to let my hair down after grueling study sessions. However, it turned into a passion, and soon enough, I found myself signing up for a marathon.

A major influence during this period was my uncle, who had been an avid runner himself. He stepped into the role of a mentor, guiding me through rigorous training sessions and offering invaluable advice. He would often remind me that "success is the result of preparation, hard work, and learning from failure." This piece of wisdom kept me going even when the going got tough.

Crossing the finish line, I felt a surge of emotion that words can hardly describe. There was a profound sense of accomplishment and relief. The dedication and perseverance that I had invested were finally paying off, and it reinforced my belief that setting and achieving goals is not just about the end result, but also about the journey and growth along the way.

This experience taught me "the early bird catches the worm." I realized that taking initiative and maintaining discipline can lead to extraordinary outcomes. Ultimately, my marathon achievement has motivated me to pursue further goals, knowing that with the right mindset and influences, anything is possible.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
O'tmishdagi tajribalarimga nazar tashlasam, yodda qoladigan muhim voqea bu mening birinchi marafonni yakunlaganim bo'lgan. Rostini aytsam, bu men uchun nafaqat jismoniy, balki ruhiy jihatdan ham ulkan yutuq edi.

Bu maqsadga erishish yo'li juda qiyin edi. Men universitet yillarida yugurishni xobbi sifatida boshladim, dastlab og'ir o'qish mashg'ulotlaridan keyin dam olish usuli sifatida. Biroq, bu ishtiyoqqa aylandi va tez orada men o'zimni marafon uchun ro'yxatdan o'tkazayotganimni angladim.

Bu davrda asosiy ta'sir ko'rsatgan odam amakim edi, u ham ishtiyoqli yuguruvchi edi. U murabbiy rolini o'z zimmasiga oldi, meni qattiq mashg'ulotlarda yo'naltirdi va bebaho maslahatlar berdi. U menga ko'pincha "muvaffaqiyat - bu tayyorgarlik, qattiq mehnat va xatolardan saboq olish natijasidir" deb eslatib turardi. Bu hikmatli so'zlar meni qiyinchiliklar paytida ham harakatga undadi.

Finish chizig'ini kesib o'tganimda, so'z bilan ta'riflab bo'lmaydigan his-tuyg'ularni his qildim. Yutuq va yengillikning chuqur tuyg'usi bor edi. Men sarmoya kiritgan fidoyilik va qat'iyat nihoyat o'z samarasini berayotgan edi va bu maqsadlarni belgilash va ularga erishish faqat yakuniy natija haqida emas, balki yo'l davomidagi sayohat va o'sish haqida ekanligiga bo'lgan ishonchimni mustahkamladi.

Bu tajriba menga "ertalab turgan qush o'ljasini oladi" degan saboqni berdi. Men tashabbus ko'rsatish va intizomni saqlash g'ayrioddiy natijalarga olib kelishi mumkinligini angladim. Oxir oqibat, marafon yutug'im meni to'g'ri fikrlash va ta'sir bilan har qanday narsaga erishish mumkinligini bilgan holda, keyingi maqsadlarga intilishga undadi.

questions.prompt: Smartphones should be banned in schools
questions.sampleA1: No phones. Bad. School is for learn.
questions.sampleA2: I think phones in school are bad. Because students play games. And they don't listen to the teacher. But maybe phones are good for emergencies.
questions.sampleB1: I think smartphones in schools are a complicated issue. On the one hand, they can be distracting for students. For example, students might be on social media instead of paying attention in class. However, smartphones can also be useful for learning. They can be used to research information quickly. So, I'm not sure if they should be completely banned.
questions.sampleB2: Right, so smartphones in schools — that’s quite a hot topic these days, and I can honestly see where both sides are coming from. On the one hand, there’s a strong case for banning them. Let's face it, phones are a huge distraction — instead of paying attention in class, plenty of students end up scrolling through social media or texting under the desk. On top of that, they can make bullying worse, because things get shared online in seconds, and there’s the whole issue of cheating in exams. Some people also argue that kids are glued to their screens far too much as it is, so a break during school hours can only do them good. On the other hand, you could say that banning phones outright is a bit heavy-handed. After all, smartphones are brilliant learning tools if they’re used properly — students can look things up, use educational apps, and get instant access to information. Not to mention, in an emergency, parents want to be able to reach their kids straight away. The thing is, banning them completely doesn’t teach young people how to use technology responsibly, which is a skill they’ll need for the rest of their lives. Personally, I reckon a total ban is going a bit too far. I’d lean towards a middle-ground approach — say, phones tucked away during lessons but allowed at break times. That way, you cut down on the distractions without wrapping students in cotton wool. At the end of the day, it’s all about striking the right balance and teaching a bit of self-discipline rather than just banning things left, right and centre.
questions.uzSampleA2: Menimcha, maktabda telefonlar yomon. Chunki o'quvchilar o'yin o'ynashadi. Va ular o'qituvchini tinglashmaydi. Lekin balki telefonlar favqulodda vaziyatlar uchun yaxshidir.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Menimcha, maktablarda smartfonlar murakkab masala. Bir tomondan, ular o'quvchilarning diqqatini chalg'itishi mumkin.
Masalan, o'quvchilar darsda diqqat bilan tinglash o'rniga ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda o'tirishlari mumkin.
Biroq, smartfonlar o'qish uchun ham foydali bo'lishi mumkin. Ulardan ma'lumotlarni tezda izlash uchun foydalanish mumkin. Shunday ekan, ularni butunlay taqiqlash kerakmi yoki yo'qmi, bilmayman.
questions.uzSampleB2: Maktablarda smartfonlarni taqiqlash masalasi bir nechta jihatlarni ko'rib chiqishni talab qiladigan murakkab masala. Taqiq, albatta, diqqatni jamlashni yaxshilashi va samarali o'rganishga to'sqinlik qiladigan chalg'ituvchi omillarni kamaytirishi mumkin, ammo u qimmatli ta'lim resurslariga kirishni ham cheklashi mumkin. Talabalar telefonlaridan tadqiqot o'tkazish, onlayn darsliklarga kirish va hamkorlikdagi loyihalar uchun foydalanishlari mumkin. Bundan tashqari, favqulodda vaziyatlarda smartfonlar muhim aloqa vositasini taklif etadi. Biroq, noto'g'ri foydalanish, kiberbulling va qaramlik ehtimolini e'tibordan chetda qoldirib bo'lmaydi. Ehtimol, qat'iy ko'rsatmalar va smartfonlardan mas'uliyatli foydalanish bo'yicha ta'lim dasturlarini o'z ichiga olgan yanada nozik yondashuv to'liq taqiqdan ko'ra samaraliroq bo'lishi mumkin.

for: Reduced Screen Time and Eye Strain.

questions.sampleAnswer:
When it comes to the debate over whether smartphones should be banned in schools, I find it quite a compelling topic with valid arguments on both sides. On one hand, banning smartphones could better focus students on their studies. Without the constant popping up of notifications, students can engage more deeply with their learning material. Furthermore, the absence of smartphones encourages more time for real-life activities, such as hanging out with friends during breaks, which is vital for developing interpersonal skills.

Moreover, reducing screen time is crucial for minimizing eye strain, which has become increasingly prevalent among young people. "Prevention is better than cure," and limiting smartphone use in school settings can help maintain students' eye health.

Conversely, there are significant drawbacks to a complete ban. Smartphones provide students with limited access to valuable information instantly. They serve as a tool for research and understanding complex topics, offering resources beyond traditional textbooks. Additionally, restricted communication could be detrimental in emergency situations where contacting parents or authorities is necessary.

Furthermore, smartphones have the potential to enhance the educational experience through apps that cater to various learning needs. It's incredibly important to acknowledge how technology can support diverse learning styles and make education more accessible and engaging.

In conclusion, while there are clear benefits to banning smartphones in schools, such as improved concentration and reduced eye strain, we must also consider the potential educational advantages and communication needs that smartphones provide. Ultimately, I believe a balanced approach, integrating limited and responsible smartphone use, might be more beneficial than an outright ban.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Smartfonlar maktablarda taqiqlanishi kerakmi degan bahsga kelganda, men bu mavzuni har ikki tomonda ham asosli dalillar bilan juda qiziqarli deb bilaman. Bir tomondan, smartfonlarni taqiqlash o‘quvchilarning o‘qishga diqqatini jamlashiga yaxshiroq yordam berishi mumkin. Doimiy bildirishnomalar paydo bo'lib turmasdan, o‘quvchilar o‘quv materiallari bilan chuqurroq shug‘ullanishlari mumkin. Bundan tashqari, smartfonlarning yo'qligi tanaffus paytida do'stlar bilan vaqt o'tkazish kabi real hayotiy mashg'ulotlar uchun ko'proq vaqt ajratishga yordam beradi, bu esa shaxslararo ko'nikmalarni rivojlantirish uchun juda muhimdir.

Bundan tashqari, ekran vaqtini qisqartirish yoshlar orasida tobora keng tarqalib borayotgan ko'z zo'riqishini kamaytirish uchun juda muhimdir. "Kasallikni davolashdan ko'ra oldini olish yaxshiroq", va maktab sharoitida smartfonlardan foydalanishni cheklash o'quvchilarning ko'z salomatligini saqlashga yordam beradi.

Aksincha, to'liq taqiqning sezilarli kamchiliklari ham bor. Smartfonlar o'quvchilarga qimmatli ma'lumotlarga bir zumda cheklangan kirish imkoniyatini beradi. Ular an'anaviy darsliklardan tashqari resurslarni taklif qilib, tadqiqot va murakkab mavzularni tushunish uchun vosita bo'lib xizmat qiladi. Bundan tashqari, cheklangan aloqa ota-onalar yoki rasmiylar bilan bog'lanish zarur bo'lgan favqulodda vaziyatlarda zararli bo'lishi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, smartfonlar turli xil o'quv ehtiyojlariga mos keladigan ilovalar orqali ta'lim tajribasini yaxshilash imkoniyatiga ega. Texnologiya turli xil o'qish uslublarini qanday qo'llab-quvvatlashi va ta'limni yanada qulay va qiziqarli qilishi mumkinligini tan olish juda muhim.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, maktablarda smartfonlarni taqiqlashning aniq afzalliklari, masalan, diqqatni jamlashning yaxshilanishi va ko'z zo'riqishining kamayishi kabi jihatlar mavjud bo'lsa-da, biz smartfonlar taqdim etadigan potentsial ta'lim afzalliklari va aloqa ehtiyojlarini ham hisobga olishimiz kerak. Oxir oqibat, men cheklangan va mas'uliyatli smartfonlardan foydalanishni integratsiya qilgan muvozanatli yondashuv to'liq taqiqdan ko'ra foydaliroq bo'lishi mumkin deb hisoblayman.
